candidates.title: MAPS: Memory-Aware Predictive Scheduling Framework for Large Language Model Serving
candidates.reason: ICML 2026 disaggregated-serving scheduler that predicts output length concurrently with prefill, calibrates uncertainty-aware upper bounds, and uses hierarchical global/local scheduling to reduce decoder memory/load imbalance; reports 42.6% lower average end-to-end latency and up to 84.8% lower tail latency.

candidates.title: PipeSwift: Revisiting Pipeline Parallelism for Large-Scale Completion-Oriented Agentic Serving
candidates.reason: Fresh agentic-serving systems paper revisiting scheduling/parallelism for job-completion-time objectives. Open-source pipeline-parallel runtime combines JCT-aware scheduling with pipeline-integrated multi-token prediction; on two 360B+ MoE models over 64 H800 GPUs reports up to 1.45x lower JCT versus SGLang wide-EP and 1.54x versus a state-of-the-art PD-disaggregated deployment.
